problem: The workshop scan was merged to protected main, but the exact-main Netlify production deploy failed during the site build before /scan could become live.
root_cause: The production build keeps STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1. The current generated public estate contained static Dutch strings that were not yet present in the immutable English translation cache, so the fail-closed localized-route builder terminated the production build with exit code 2.
prevention: Keep production fail-closed for static English translation completeness.
Before promotion, compare the post-transform public-string set with the canonical translation cache and add missing translations in the same candidate.
Do not solve this incident by setting STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=0.
Production closure still requires exact-main Netlify commit parity and browser readback of /scan.

historical_replay: Production Source Snapshot run 36397804474 failed at the exact-source Netlify deploy with build exit code 2.
Required netlify-build-parity showed STATIC_I18N_PARTIAL_CACHE_FALLBACK with 17 missing strings when its non-production cache requirement was disabled.
shadow: Static i18n cache patch covers the current missing public-string set without disabling the production fail-closed contract.
canary: Exact-main Netlify deployment followed by /scan production readback.
evaluation.expected_invariant: STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE remains 1 and every current public translatable string has an immutable English cache entry before production promotion.
